title: Complex to Magnitude-Angle
text: Compute magnitude and phase angle of complex signal using CORDIC algorithm, 2 inputs, 3 outputs, {Output format} sets Output signal format Magnitude and; {Number of iterations source} sets the source of number of iterations, {Number of iterations} sets the number of CORDIC iterations positive, {Angle format} sets the output angle format, {Scale output} sets the scales output and {Scaling method} sets the implementation of CORDIC gain scaling. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Magnitude
ports.summary: Magnitude of the input signal scalar | vector

ports.name: Angle
ports.summary: Angle of the input signal scalar | vector

params.name: Number of iterations source
params.values: Source of number of iterations Auto (default) | Property

params.name: Number of iterations
params.values: Number of CORDIC iterations positive integer

params.name: Output format
params.values: Output signal format Magnitude and Angle (default) | Magnitude | Angle

params.name: Scaling method
params.values: Implementation of CORDIC gain scaling Shift-Add (default) | Multipliers
